name: io.github.shreeshman/lineupify
description: Spotify playlists from a festival lineup, a genre or mood, an artist you like, another playlist, or a blend of several people's taste. Reads, analyses, compares and merges playlists. Bring your own Spotify client ID.

environment_variables.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Client ID of your own Spotify app (developer.spotify.com/dashboard, redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback). Optional if saved with `lineupify-mcp setup`.

environment_variables.name: LASTFM_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional Last.fm API key for tag, similar-artist and per-country data.
